question: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has so far presented four union budgets. She became _________ woman till now to achieve this feat.(January 2023)
solution:
**The correct answer is - __second__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman__** became the **__second woman__** to present the Union Budget four times, as of January 2023.
 
• She joined the ranks of **__Indira Gandhi__**, who was the first woman to have presented the budget four times.
 
• This achievement highlights her significant role in Indian finance and governance.
 
• **__The Union Budget__** is one of the most crucial economic events in India, and presenting it multiple times is a rare accomplishment for any finance minister.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi__**

 __
 
• Indira Gandhi, former Prime Minister of India, is the first woman who presented the Union Budget four times.
 
• Her tenure as a finance minister showcased the early female participation in high-level governance in India.
 
 
 
• **Union Budget Significance__**
 
 
• The Union Budget is presented annually and is the financial plan for the government for the upcoming year.
 
• It impacts various sectors of the economy, including education, healthcare, infrastructure, and more.
 
• The Finance Minister plays a critical role in shaping economic policies and decisions that affect the entire nation.
